mapper.sql: select id, instance_id, proxy_node_id, port, download_mbps, upload_mbps, expire_time, status, last_apply_result, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from res_proxy_node_rate_limit
mapper.select: where proxy_node_id = #{proxyNodeId} and status = 'active' order by update_time desc, id desc limit 1
where instance_id = #{instanceId} and status = 'active' order by update_time desc, id desc
where status = 'active' and expire_time is not null and expire_time <= #{now} order by expire_time asc
mapper.insert: insert into res_proxy_node_rate_limit (instance_id, proxy_node_id, port, download_mbps, upload_mbps, expire_time, status, last_apply_result, remark, create_by, create_time, update_time) values (#{instanceId}, #{proxyNodeId}, #{port}, #{downloadMbps}, #{uploadMbps}, #{expireTime}, #{status}, #{lastApplyResult}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update res_proxy_node_rate_limit set status = #{status}, last_apply_result = #{lastApplyResult}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
